$comment: Canned replies for the stand-in platform (demo/fake-platform.js in the case desk engine), so this desk can be tried with no platform. Each key is a distinctive part of a case title, matched without regard to case. The stand-in adds its own first line saying that the reply is canned. The replies follow the right answers in demo-bank/SCENARIOS.md (Cards). Every date and figure was worked out by a script from the bank's data at the bank date 2026-11-24 (start the bank with BANK_TODAY=2026-11-24). 'replies' answers a request for the proposal. 'actions' answers the message sent when the member of staff has confirmed: the first answer says the requests wait for approval, as on a platform with approval rules. 'followUps' answers 'Ask for the outcome again' with the references the bank gives once they are approved (a dispute DSP-6002, a replacement RPL-7001 and RPL-7002, as a fresh bank gives them when the cases are carried out in the order of the list). The two cases that need no change have no action. A case whose title holds the words 'Failure drill' is the second case under another name: its first request to carry out is answered with an error and the second works, so the failed screen and Try again can be seen. Card numbers are masked: the last four digits only. Start the stand-in with DESK_CONFIG pointing at desk.config.json in this folder.

Summary

The card is active and every payment the system lists was made in Meridia. The charge of 22 Nov 2026 repeats three payments of the same amount to the same merchant, on 24 Aug 2026, 23 Sep 2026 and 23 Oct 2026.
He told the bank on 22 Nov 2026 (CNT-5206) that the charge is fraud and asked for his money back. No dispute is open.
